findings.evidence: The structure at line 74 contains `toFun` plus only the proposition-valued fields `involutive` and `mem_H`; no `HeckeAntiInvolution.ext` declaration occurs in the repository.
findings.fix: Add an `@[ext]` theorem reducing equality of anti-involutions to equality of `toFun` (with proof fields discharged by proof irrelevance).
findings.issue: `HeckeAntiInvolution` has no `@[ext]` theorem, so consumers cannot establish equality from equality of the sole data field `toFun`; its remaining fields are propositions.

findings.evidence: Repository grep finds `exists_bar_eq` only at its declaration and calls on lines 251, 344, 348, 382, and 384 of this file, all inside private proof machinery.
findings.fix: Make `exists_bar_eq` private; retain the reusable characteristic result `bar_mem_doubleCoset_self`, from which the decomposition is immediately obtained with `mem_doubleCoset.mp`.

summary: The bundled anti-involution lacks an extensionality theorem, and one proof-specific decomposition lemma is unnecessarily public.
